Name: The Hedgewitchs Almanac
Author: NesrynRoseAstra
Description:
[left][size=6]🌿✨ The Hedgewitch's Almanac ✨🌿[/size]
[i][i]                          A cozy witchcraft & herbalism mod for Stardew Valley[/i] 🔮🐸🕯️
[/i]
Step into the quiet arts. 🌙 Gather moonlit herbs, brew little miracles in a bubbling cauldron, ride a lantern-lit broom across the valley, and read the cards for the people you love. The Hedgewitch's Almanac turns your farm into a cozy witch's cottage, with new crops, remedies, recipes, tools and enchanted objects. 🍄💜
[line]
[heading]📦 What You Need[/heading]
[table][tr][th]Requirement[/th]
[th]Why[/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td]🧩 [b]SMAPI[/b] 4.0+[/td]
[td]Loads mods[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]📜 [b]Content Patcher[/b] 2.9.0+[/td]
[td]Powers the items, crops and recipes[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]📖 [b]Parchment[/b] (PeacefulEnd) 1.0.0+[/td]
[td]Makes the in-game Almanac book[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]🧹 [b]Hedgewitch's Broom[/b] 1.6.0[/td]
[td][b]Included in the download.[/b] Powers brooms, tarot, cauldron, altar and more[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]Stardew Valley 1.6+ is required. Install both folders from the download (
[code]TheHedgewitchsAlmanac[/code]and
[code]HedgewitchsBroom[/code]) into your
[code]Mods[/code]folder. 🌱
[line]
[heading]🌟 Magical Tools & Objects[/heading]
🧹 Brooms
[list]
[*]🐸 [b]Frogbloom Broom:[/b] a cottagecore broom with a tiny frog passenger. Select it and press the action button to ride.[/*]
[*]🏮 [b]Lantern Broom (400g):[/b] a swift, steady broom with [i]no bounce[/i], about 50% faster, with a softly swaying lantern.[/*]
[*]⚙️ [b]Broom Upgrades:[/b] Waxed Handle Wrap, Gleaming Lantern Wick and Stardust Bristle Binding make your broom faster still.[/*]
[/list]🔮 Divination
[list]
[*]🔮 [b]Crystal Ball:[/b] read the weather, summon rain once a day, or pass the hours.[/*]
[*]🃏 [b]Valley Tarot:[/b] draw a card each day from a ten-card deck, with brand-new illustrated art for the Empress, Hermit, Hanged One and Devil. Your card can bless you (or warn you!).[/*]
[*]🕯️ [b]Fortune Table:[/b] give a tarot reading to the villagers near you. Each person can be read once a day, and each reading warms your friendship. 💞[/*]
[/list]🧪 Cauldron & Altar
[list]
[*]🫕 [b]Witch's Cauldron:[/b] drop in up to three herbs and stir. Your herbs and the day's tarot card decide which of [b]five potions[/b] you get: Vigor, Fortune, Stoneskin, Green Thumb or Clarity. Draw a lucky card for a double batch. Draw an unlucky one and you may brew a Murky Brew. 😅[/*]
[*]🌙 [b]Moon Altar:[/b] after dusk, offer an herb or a gem. Wake to a day-long blessing: [b]Forager's Blessing[/b] or [b]Moon's Favor[/b]. ✨[/*]
[/list]💧 The Dewdrop Wand
Three spells, switched with [b]Shift + action button[/b] (or left trigger):
[list]
[*]💦 [b]Droplets of Dew:[/b] waters crops near you.[/*]
[*]🌧️ [b]Gentle Downpour:[/b] waters [i]every[/i] crop on your farm and greenhouse.[/*]
[*]🐾 [b]Fill the Bowl:[/b] fills your pet's water bowl from anywhere.[/*]
[/list][line]
[heading]🌿 Herbs, Crops & Foraging[/heading]
[list]
[*]🌱 [b]Garden herbs:[/b] Moonmint, Comfrey, Sunpetal, Witchroot and Yarrow.[/*]
[*]🌸 [b]Magical flowers:[/b] Starbell, Foxglow and Duskrose, plus three hardy [b]year-round[/b] crops: Hearthsage, Moonbell and Mossheart.[/*]
[*]🌧️ [b]Rare finds:[/b] Tideglass Bloom (rainy summer beach) and Rainmoss (rainy Secret Woods).[/*]
[*]❄️ [b]NEW winter herbs:[/b] [b]Rimeleaf[/b], [b]Yulewort[/b] and the rare [b]Frostember[/b], found while foraging in winter![/*]
[/list][heading]🍯 Brews, Remedies & Cozy Cooking[/heading]
[list]
[*]🧴 [b]Apothecary Brewing Station:[/b] brew tonics, elixirs, salves, poultices and teas.[/*]
[*]❄️ [b]Winter brews:[/b] Frostward Draught and Yule Cordial.[/*]
[*]🍰 [b]Cozy kitchen recipes:[/b] Mooncakes, Honey Scones, Witchroot Chowder, Berry Tart, Mushroom Stew, plus new [b]Rimeleaf Winter Tea[/b], [b]Yulewort Spice Cake[/b] and [b]Frostember Jam Tart[/b]. Every recipe comes by mail the first time you keep the matching herb overnight. 💌[/*]
[/list][heading]🐸 Familiar, Skills & Stories[/heading]
[list]
[*]🐸 [b]Marshlight Frog Familiar:[/b] a wearable witch-hat frog friend who reacts to the weather, your herbs and your readings.[/*]
[*]📈 [b]Herbalism skill:[/b] level up by gathering and brewing for bonus yields, better remedies and special rare finds.[/*]
[*]📚 [b]Witchy errands:[/b] small quests from Caroline, Linus and the Wizard.[/*]
[/list][heading]📖 Guidebook & Field Journal[/heading]
[list]
[*]📖 [b]The Hedgewitch's Almanac:[/b] an illustrated in-game book covering every herb, brew, recipe and tool, with winter pages too.[/*]
[*]📔 [b]Field Journal:[/b] tracks your herbs, learned recipes, Herbalism progress and your familiar.[/*]
[*]💌 New saves receive a welcome letter with your book, journal and broom. Existing saves get a catch-up letter.[/*]
[/list][line]
[heading]🔄 Updating From an Older Version[/heading]
Version 0.8.0 changes the mod's IDs. [b]Back up your saves first.[/b] The included Hedgewitch's Broom 1.6.0 automatically renames your existing items, recipes, quests and progress the first time you load. 💾
[heading]🙏 Credits & Notes[/heading]
[list]
[*]🎨 Created by [b]Nesryn Astra Rose[/b] 💜[/*]

[/list][/left]
